summary:
Definitive ranking of the best uncensored/abliterated open-source models under 3B parameters for cybersecurity use (September 2026). Two approaches covered:

1. Abliterated models (refusal vector surgically removed) - recommended
2. Dolphin fine-tunes (trained without refusal data)

Top picks:
- #1: Qwen 2.5 Coder 3B Abliterated (best for code security)
- #2: Dolphin 3.0 Qwen 2.5 3B (best all-rounder uncensored)
- #3: Phi-4 Mini Abliterated (best reasoning per param)
- #4: DeepSeek-R1-Distill 1.5B (ultra-lightweight chain-of-thought)
- #5: SmolLM2 1.7B (ultra-edge)

Includes exact HuggingFace repo names, Ollama pull commands, and GGUF quantization options for each model.
